question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**bias**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate title of the given passage is 'Nutrition in children'.
 
• The most appropriate word for the second blank is 'bias'.
 
• In the given sentence blank is followed by a preposition that is against. Hence, we know that 'bias against' makes a prepositional phrase.
 
• It means 'the action of supporting or opposing a particular person or thing in an unfair way, because of allowing personal opinions to influence your judgment (व्यक्तिगत राय को आपके फैसले को प्रभावित करने की अनुमति देने के कारण किसी विशेष व्यक्ति या वस्तु का अनुचित तरीके से समर्थन या विरोध करने की क्रिया)'.
 
 
• *Example: There was clear evidence of a strong **bias** against her.*
 
 
 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **advanced**: of a high level. (उच्‍चतर स्‍तर का)
 
• **neutral**: not supporting or belonging to either side in an argument, war, etc. (किसी विवाद, युद्घ आदि में तटस्‍थ)
 
• **law**: an official rule of a country or state that says what people may or may not do. (क़ानून, विधि; किसी देश या राज्‍य का अधिकारिक नियम जो बताता है कि लोग क्‍या करें या न करें)

 
 
 

**Correct Passage:__*** The most urgent areas of attention and immediate action are nutrition, health and education of children, whose well-being reflects the health of the society and caring outlook of the polity. Since the causes of malnutrition of children are many, like exploding population, **bias** against the female child, weak and suffering mothers, the remedy calls for ‘care of the mother and care by mother’, (3)________, an effective control over population explosion. Ignorance on what food should be taken is another (4)________ factor that results in malnutrition among women and children. The implementation of various schemes to fight the (5)________ of malnutrition and undernourishment of children requires planning, co-ordination and monitoring by high-powered bodies right down to the village level.*

44:Tcf8,

The correct answer is '**Besides**'.
